name: @japp/extension
description: Browser extension (WXT + TypeScript, Manifest V3 per spec §5.2). M02-W07 scaffolds the real minimal MV3 feasibility substrate: one background service worker, one loopback-only feasibility content script, and one closed typed probe protocol, proven in bundled Playwright Chromium with a persistent context. No product UI, native host, database, model runtime, scanner, resolver, driver, fill, or submit capability exists; those arrive in M02-W08+ and productionization (including React UI) in M17.
